title: Project Management: Fundamentals, Frameworks, and Roles

questions.question: Which of the following best defines a project?
options: A temporary endeavor undertaken to create a unique product, service, or result
A collection of programs managed strategically
questions.answer: A temporary endeavor undertaken to create a unique product, service, or result

questions.question: The term 'temporary' in a project means that the project itself and its resulting output will be short-lived.
Projects develop in incremental steps, starting broadly defined and becoming clearer over time. This key attribute is known as Progressive Elaboration.

Which of the following constitutes the 'Triple Constraint' in project management?

Which of the following is NOT typically a criterion for project success?
options: Met scope, time, and cost goals
Eliminated all competitors in the market
Results achieved the primary objective (e.g., high ROI)
questions.answer: Eliminated all competitors in the market

questions.question: Which of the following is considered a key reason projects fail?
One of the reasons projects fail is the inability to manage changing scope or requirements.
While 'Management' deals with day-to-day operational execution, 'Leadership' focuses on:
options: Long-term vision, big-picture goals, and inspiring people
questions.answer: Long-term vision, big-picture goals, and inspiring people

questions.question: Building trust, active listening, and verbal communication fall under Soft skills.
According to the PMI Ethics Code Principles, project managers should only accept tasks that:
options: Match their background, experience, and skills
Can be completed within one month
questions.answer: Match their background, experience, and skills
